focus: Medical and health programs for high school students

programs.name: Neuroscience Grand Rounds Certificate
programs.deadlineNote: Registration closes Oct 29, 2026. Late registration not accepted.
programs.dates: Monthly sessions, Sept 2026 to May 2027, 6 PM Pacific
requirements: Attend at least 8 of 10 sessions to earn the certificate

programs.name: KP LAUNCH High School Internship
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Nov 16, 2026. Closes Jan 8, 2027 at 5 PM PT.
programs.eligibility: Ages 16 to 19 by June 1, 2027; live in a Northern California KP service area; authorized to work in the U.S.
requirements: Drug screen and health checks if hired

programs.name: researcHStart
programs.host: University of Chicago Medicine and partners
programs.deadlineNote: Application and both recommendations due 11:59 PM CT.
programs.eligibility: Juniors or seniors, 16+ by June 14, 2027; live in Illinois or Lake County, Indiana
requirements: Online application with GPA and transcript
Two recommendations, one from a teacher

programs.name: NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP)
programs.location: Bethesda, MD and other NIH campuses
programs.costDetail: Free, monthly stipend set by NIH
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Oct 13, 2026. Closes Jan 26, 2027 at noon ET. References due Feb 2.
programs.eligibility: High school seniors who turn 18 by Sept 30, 2027; U.S. citizen or permanent resident

programs.name: Summer High School Research Internship
programs.eligibility: Juniors or seniors, age 16, minimum 3.5 GPA

programs.name: RITMS Summer Research Program
programs.host: Rutgers Institute for Translational Medicine and Science
programs.deadlineNote: The program lists Feb 1 each year. Reviewed on a rolling basis from November, so apply early.
programs.dates: Third week of June to second week of August
programs.eligibility: 16 by start; entering grade 10, 11 or 12; GPA 3.0+
requirements: Two references (one science or math teacher)

programs.name: HOPP Summer Student Program
programs.eligibility: Juniors, 16+ by June 2027, 3.5 science GPA, live within 25 miles of MSK in NY, NJ or CT

programs.name: Summer Student Research Program
programs.deadlineNote: Application opens December 2026. Date based on last year.
programs.dates: About seven weeks, mid-June to late July
programs.eligibility: Grades 10 to 12, 16+ by June 1; one year each of math and biology; economically, educationally or medically disadvantaged
requirements: Check the site in December for the full list

programs.name: STEP-UP High School Research
programs.deadlineNote: Usually mid-February. Date based on last year.
programs.eligibility: Juniors and seniors 16+, GPA 3.0+, from groups underrepresented in biomedical research

programs.name: Neuroscience High School Virtual Summer Program
programs.deadlineNote: UCLA posts the real deadline in December 2026. Date based on last year.
requirements: No transcript or recommendation letters needed

programs.name: Stanford Institutes of Medicine Summer Research (SIMR)
programs.costDetail: No tuition; $40 application fee (can be waived); need-based stipend
programs.deadlineNote: Stanford says late February 2027. Application opens Dec 18, 2026.
programs.eligibility: Class of 2027 or 2028, 16+ by June 2027, live and attend school in the U.S., citizen or green card holder. Bay Area students strongly favored.

programs.name: Pediatrics Internship Program
programs.costDetail: No tuition; $50 application fee (can be waived); $3,000 stipend if in need
programs.eligibility: Rising juniors and seniors from 7 Bay Area counties, 16+, GPA 3.0+

programs.name: ISPEED in Biomedical Engineering
programs.costDetail: Free: tuition, housing, meals and travel covered; up to $2,400 need-based stipend
programs.deadlineNote: Applications open early 2027. Last year closed March 16.
programs.dates: Four weeks, late June to late July
programs.eligibility: 10th or 11th graders, U.S. citizen or permanent resident, age 15 to 17
requirements: One recommendation (math or science teacher or counselor)
Official transcript sent by your school

programs.name: Stanford Medical Youth Science Program (SMYSP)
programs.dates: Five weeks, late June to late July
programs.eligibility: Juniors from low-income or first-generation families living in Northern California
requirements: Check the site for essays and recommendations

programs.name: Student Research Internship
programs.costDetail: Free; paid or for school credit depending on funding
programs.eligibility: 16+ by internship start; interest in genomics or digital health

programs.name: Disease Detective Camp
programs.eligibility: Rising juniors and seniors, 16+ on the first day
requirements: Application form from the camp FAQ
Check in January for the full list

programs.name: Summer Medical Academy
programs.costDetail: About $3,000 plus $50 registration; limited scholarships for some San Diego County schools
programs.dates: Two-week sessions in June and July

programs.name: Penn Summer Academies (Biomedical Research)
programs.costDetail: About $6,700 for 2 weeks, $10,050 for 3 weeks, plus $100 application fee
programs.deadlineNote: Rolling admission until full. Apply early.

programs.name: NYLF Medicine & Health Care
programs.deadlineNote: Enrollment is rolling until sessions fill.
programs.dates: About one week in June or July
